b1-07.title: My new smartphone
b1-07.story: Anna got a new [[smartphone]] for her birthday. First, she changed her [[ringtone]] to a quiet song. Then she turned on [[Bluetooth]] and connected her old [[headset]]. On Sunday, she visited her grandparents in the village. There was no [[signal]] in their kitchen, so she couldn't call Max. Grandpa was on the roof, putting up a new TV [[antenna]]. Soon her battery was low, and she had no [[USB]] cable with her. Luckily, Grandma had a [[power bank]] in her bag. "Now my new [[device]] is ready for village life," Anna laughed.

b1-08.title: Messages and chat
b1-08.story: Anna had a busy evening with her phone. First, she got an [[SMS]] with a code from her bank. Then Max left a [[message]] in the group [[chat]]: "Concert tickets are on sale!" He added a [[link]] to the ticket website. With one [[click]], Anna bought two tickets. She checked her [[inbox]] and found the email with both tickets. Max wrote, "Bring my ticket to school tomorrow, [[plz]]!" Anna sent a quick [[reply]] with a happy [[emoji]].

b1-09.title: A video call
b1-09.story: Anna wanted to join a summer film course through an [[online service]]. Her laptop was broken, so she went to an [[internet cafe]] near her school. She entered her [[username]] and password on the course website. The site asked for a [[scan]] of her passport, so she uploaded one. Then an error appeared, and she took a [[screenshot]] of it for the help team. The next day, she had a [[video chat]] with the course teacher. Anna said she loved making films with her dad's old [[video camera]]. She wanted to send a short film, but the [[video file]] was too big. The teacher watched it on the course site, though the [[video player]] was slow. "Welcome to the course!" he said with a smile.

b1-10.title: A blogger's day
b1-10.story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[blogger]] in Kyiv. On her [[blog]], she writes about games and coffee. Every morning, she makes coffee with a paper [[filter]] and takes a [[selfie]] with her cup. Today she was making [[content]] about a new online game. In the game, she found a rare [[item]], a golden sword. She posted a video, and a [[comment]] appeared at once: "Amazing find!" Soon, golden swords became a small [[trend]] among her followers. Later, she even got a friend [[request]] from the game's designer. Sofia was so happy that she made a second cup of coffee.

b1-11.title: On TV tonight
b1-11.story: On Friday evening, Anna's family looked at the TV guide. Mama wanted to watch a [[talk show]] with a [[celebrity]] chef. Taras wanted a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Dad preferred the scary [[thriller]] on channel two. Anna checked her phone for more [[info]] about the films. "There's a [[fantasy]] movie at nine," she said. "In it, people pray to a golden [[idol]] in a dark forest." Her friend Lisa is in the movie's [[fan club]] and loves it. In the end, the whole family watched it, and even Dad enjoyed it.

b1-12.title: Clips and podcasts
b1-12.story: Anna and Max went on a road trip with Max's family. Max made a [[playlist]] of their favorite songs for the car. Anna downloaded a [[podcast]] about history for the long road. Max's dad listened to his favorite [[radio show]] on [[online radio]]. On the way, Max filmed a funny [[video clip]] of a goat in the road. He posted it with a short [[tweet]]: "Look who stopped our car!" That evening, Anna found a [[clip]] of the same goat on a news site! Max recorded a thank-you song and sent her the [[audio file]]. Anna made a [[slide show]] of their trip photos for everyone.

b1-13.title: Setting up a computer
b1-13.story: Anna's dad works in [[IT]], so he helped her set up a new computer. First, he connected a big [[monitor]] with a bright, clear [[display]]. Then the internet stopped working, so Dad restarted the [[modem]]. He also put a [[web camera]] on top for her online classes. Anna put her memory card into the [[slot]] to copy her photos. The card held sixteen [[gigabytes|gigabyte]] of pictures from the summer. Her school project was only one [[megabyte]], and she saved it in PDF [[format]]. But the school website was down because of a problem with the [[server]]. An hour later, it worked again, and Anna sent her project just in time.

b1-14.title: Shopping for clothes
b1-14.story: On Saturday, Anna and Ira went to the [[shopping center]] to buy clothes. Ira loves [[fashion]] and reads about new styles every week. Anna needed something warm for the winter. She tried on a thick wool [[jumper]], but it was too big. Then Ira found a soft [[pullover]] in light brown. "[[Beige|beige]] is perfect for you," she said. Anna also chose a gray [[hoodie]] made of [[cotton]] for the gym. At the last shop, Ira bought a silver [[bracelet]] for her mama. They went home tired but very happy.
